micropubr colour palettes

Source: R/mp_palette.R
mp_palette.Rd

Colourblind-tolerant palettes designed for microbiome figures: qualitative palettes for taxa and groups, plus sequential and diverging ramps for heatmaps and fold-changes.

Usage

mp_palette(name = "taxa10", n = NULL, reverse = FALSE)

Arguments

name

Palette name. One of "taxa10", "taxa20", "taxa40", "okabe", "groups2".."groups8", "sequential", "viridis", "diverging".

n

Number of colours to return. For qualitative palettes, if n exceeds the palette size a distinct fallback ramp is generated (with a message). For sequential/diverging palettes the colours are interpolated to exactly n. Defaults to the full palette.

reverse

Reverse the colour order.

Value

A character vector of hex colours.

Examples

mp_palette("taxa10")
#>  [1] "#0072B2" "#E69F00" "#009E73" "#D55E00" "#CC79A7" "#56B4E9" "#F0E442"
#>  [8] "#332288" "#44AA99" "#117733"
mp_palette("diverging", n = 7)
#> [1] "#2166AC" "#4F92C3" "#96C3DC" "#F7F7F7" "#F1AE93" "#DA644F" "#B2182B"
